title: Retained Terrain Surface, Pixel-Seam, Pond Contour, and Frame-Plan Repair
changes: Added a native-resolution GPU terrain scene surface rebuilt only on scene or semantic terrain revision changes.
Reduced normal gameplay terrain submission from thousands of per-cell quads to one retained terrain texture.
Kept developer overlays and world-paint authoring on the editable per-cell renderer.
Quantized camera zoom to integer output tile widths and snapped the projected terrain origin after scaling.
Stopped idle autotile polling from invalidating terrain caches.
Rebuilt the freshwater lake from a smoothed deep core with constant-width Euclidean shallow-water and mud-bank rings.
Normalized dirt, sand, and wet-sand interior source cells to prevent random variant seams against authored transitions.
Regenerated direct-LPC terrain evidence for the revised open-world contour.
